summary: advance refused a task whose gate was green minutes earlier: gate-cache.json holds a single {task, signature, ok} record, so gating a second task of the same wave overwrites the first; next --wave fan-out then needs gate+advance strictly interleaved per task
cause: src/core/gates.ts writes one record to .agent-flow/gate-cache.json instead of a map keyed by task id
solution: key the cache by task id ({ [taskId]: record }), keep the signature check per task, migrate the old single-record shape on read
